sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: The Users page lets you search and view accounts in the Google Workspace directory.

sections.heading: Search
paragraphs: You need to run a search before any list appears:

bullets.desc: Type part of a first name, last name or email address.
Use the Clear button to reset the search results.
Name, email and account status (active / suspended) are shown.
Results are paginated; use the button below the list to load the next batch.

sections.heading: User Detail
paragraphs: Click a user row to open its detail page. From there you can edit the user, suspend the account, manage groups and assign a Gmail signature.
